owner.title: Guidance visual analysis

vet.title: Clinical image analysis
vet.subtitle: Upload a skin photo so the model marks the lesions, or an X-ray to see the likely conditions. The result is supportive and is kept as a background for the visit.
vet.consultationHint: Optional: links the study to the visit
vet.skinSubtitle: Object detection: labeled boxes with confidence
vet.xraySubtitle: Classification: probability per finding, no boxes
vet.skinTip: Frame the lesion with good light. Only areas with 50% confidence or more are marked.
vet.xrayTip: Upload the plate in grayscale. If the image has color, it is rejected because it does not look like an X-ray.
vet.backgroundText: The Clinical assistant can now use this analysis when it drafts the SOAP note for the visit.
vet.waitingText: Pick the patient and the image type, then upload the file.
vet.processingText: Sending the image to the vision model…
vet.legal: Guidance result from the model. Interpretation and diagnosis belong to the veterinarian.

descriptions.demodicosis: Hairless, scaly areas consistent with Demodex mites. A skin scraping is needed to confirm it.
descriptions.dermatitis: Redness and inflammation of the skin in the marked area. It can be caused by allergies, friction or an infection.
descriptions.micosis: Lesion that looks like a fungal infection. Your vet can confirm it with a culture or a Wood's lamp.
descriptions.hipersensibilidad: Skin reaction consistent with an allergy (food, environmental or flea).
descriptions.dermatofitosis: Round lesion consistent with ringworm. It is contagious: avoid direct contact until the visit.
